component.name: Bluetooth Proximity Locker
component.summary: Lock your screen when your Bluetooth device leaves range

description.p: Bluetooth Proximity Locker automatically locks your computer screen when your paired Bluetooth device (such as your phone) moves out of range, and unlocks it when you return.

ul.li: Pair your phone or other device with your computer.
Configure the device address via GSettings.
The daemon monitors the device connection via the BlueZ D-Bus API.
Screen locks automatically when the device disconnects.
Screen unlocks automatically when the device reconnects.
No deprecated tools — uses modern BlueZ D-Bus interfaces.
No root required — works entirely over D-Bus.
Configurable freeze window prevents re-locking immediately after you return.
Configurable disconnect delay guards against brief Bluetooth dropouts.

description.p: Initial Vala release with reactive BlueZ D-Bus integration, replacing the old Python/l2ping approach.
